rejection_reasons: The request profile has boundary timing but no per-run CPU/GPU decomposition.
The dmon case studies are aggregate GPU samples and cannot be converted into gpu_seconds_at_reference.
The standalone CUDA matmul benchmark is not representative of vLLM/SWE-agent request phases.
The paired thin/control record has aggregate host and server metrics, not per-request device time.
claim_boundary: No fitted simulator, prediction, or held-out error is reported until at least two measured or explicitly calibrated decomposed records exist.
